output.reason: Evidence supports that for Tier 3 UCBs, for floating-rate business-purpose loans to individuals/Micro & Small Enterprises, no pre-payment charges apply only when the sanctioned amount/limit is up to ₹50 lakh (Tier 3 shall not levy for loans up to ₹50 lakh). Evidence also shows the example loan amount is ₹6,000,000 (>₹5,000,000 i.e., >₹50 lakh), so the “up to ₹50 lakh” condition would not be met. However, the claim’s conclusion that the specific no-charge rule does not apply to “this loan” is not fully supported because the evidence does not explicitly establish that the loan in the example is a floating-rate loan (the no-charge rule is explicitly limited to floating-rate loans).
